newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telebras still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telebras still a buy.

text.p: -- Robert Flemings in a report reiterated its buy recommendation for Brazil's Telebras common stocks after the company announced a proposed divident payment of 1.878 reais per 1,000 stocks.
-- "If confirmed, this would represent a pay-out ratio of 18 percent and yield of 1.7 percent," it said.
-- Although significantly below expectations, the dividend per share would still be 22 percent higher year-on-year, the report said.

-- "More importantly, lower dividend payments this year will enhance dividend growth going forward. Furthermore, higher profitability in 1996 has for the first time since 1994 equalized dividend payments to both classes of shares, thus affirming our long preference for common shares," it added.
-- Telebras common stock was 0.79 percent lower at 112.11 reais earlier on the Sao Paulo bourse.
